feature: response-only borrowed prefix slices for large ordinary gRPC unary responses

candidate.design: ResponseOptions accepted a borrowed body_prefix. Large writeUnaryResponse messages wrote the five-byte gRPC prefix and payload through writeDataSlicesPreparedTrackedUntil instead of a staged framed allocation. Request handling stayed unchanged.

scope.workload: SharedChannel shared-unary persistent round trip, 262144-byte request and response

benchmark_method.schedule: five ABBA rounds; baseline, candidate, candidate, baseline
benchmark_method.host: shared host with unrelated load; no CPU pinning
benchmark_method.metric: ns_per_roundtrip from the benchmark result record

correctness.focused_tests: 146/146 body-prefix tests and 145/145 large-message tests passed
correctness.note: correctness was not the reason for rejection

resolution: The response-prefix source changes and tests were reverted. The accepted shared-unary request ownership and duplex combined-slice burst remain in place.
